title: Simple Project Planning and Implementation Pack
description: Repeatable benchmark tasks for comparing model planning quality and first-slice implementation behavior on a small Python CLI project.

tasks.title: Plan the smallest safe done-command slice
tasks.objective: Measure whether the model can inspect a small repo and decompose one missing feature into a narrow grounded slice.
tasks.prompt: Inspect repository at Projects/PersonalAI/personal_ai_mvp/training_examples/benchmark_projects/python_task_cli and plan the smallest safe implementation slice to add a done command that marks a task complete and persists it. Keep the plan grounded in the current files and tests.
expected_signals: avoids pretending the feature is already implemented
notes: Use this to compare planning quality on a controlled project.

tasks.title: Draft only the first done-command slice
tasks.objective: Measure whether the agent runtime can inspect the repo and draft a compact first slice without hallucinating full completion.
tasks.prompt: Inspect repository at Projects/PersonalAI/personal_ai_mvp/training_examples/benchmark_projects/python_task_cli. Draft only the first safe slice for a done command that marks one task complete and persists it. Stay concrete about target files and validation, and do not claim the repo was edited.
anti_signals: returns a huge unrelated code dump
notes: Use this to compare implementation drafting behavior.
